description: This file provides backend logic for handling CRUD operations, attachment processing, and interaction with email template entities within the SuiteCRM module 'EmailTemplates'. It manages actions such as updating, copying, uploading attachments, and retrieving email template data, triggered via HTTP requests.

classes.name: EmailTemplateFormBase
classes.description: A class responsible for managing email template form processing, especially attachments and images.

methods.name: handleAttachmentsProcessImages
methods.description: Handles processing of attachments and images for an email template bean.
